text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
When I announced my retirement, my sworn 
ally spoke of retiring as well. Is that 
his way of taking responsibility?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
But that thing is an angel bestowing 
courage! In fact, it brought Vodka's 
talent into full bloom effortlessly. 
Shutting down that potential goes against 
my entire aesthetic!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That day, drunk on my potential, that guy 
said: we can achieve a feat greater than 
even the "MC Rotation." I—must fulfill my 
responsibility for pouring that drink!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And so, we share another toast. Our next 
toast will celebrate back-to-back 
victories: the pinnacle of miles, the 
Yasuda Kinen, and the king of medium 
distances, the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Rekindle the light in your eyes! First up, 
the Kobe Shimbun Hai! Aiming for a 
glorious comeback on a battleground of the 
same distance as the Nippon Derby!
